title: Meridian Grid Infrastructure — FY26 guidance cut after tariff order deferred
summary: The state regulator has still not notified the transmission tariff order. Meridian Grid trimmed FY26 revenue guidance to ₹8,900 crore and said margins stay under pressure until the order lands.
evidence: Meridian Grid Infrastructure cut its FY26 revenue guidance to ₹8,900 crore after the state regulator deferred the transmission tariff order.

title: Surya Technologies — cloud services revenue up 22% year on year
summary: Cloud services carried the quarter while India enterprise deals stayed steady. Operating margin slipped to 14.2% from 17.8% as infrastructure spend rose ahead of new capacity.
evidence: Surya Technologies Limited reported 22% year-on-year growth in cloud services revenue, driven by enterprise demand in India.

title: ABC Technologies — Q4 revenue up 18%, operating margin contracts
summary: Revenue reached ₹1,240 crore for the quarter, but operating margin fell to 14.2% from 17.8% on higher cloud infrastructure and hiring costs.
evidence: ABC Technologies operating margin declined from 17.8% to 14.2% due to higher cloud infrastructure costs and expanded hiring.

title: Nalanda Finance — small finance bank licence granted
summary: The regulator cleared Nalanda Finance's transition to a small finance bank, opening deposit-taking from the March quarter and lowering its wholesale funding cost.
evidence: Nalanda Finance received final approval to operate as a small finance bank, allowing it to raise retail deposits from the March quarter.

title: Vantage Steel — coking coal costs squeeze EBITDA per tonne
summary: Coking coal landed cost rose 11% quarter on quarter, pulling EBITDA per tonne down ₹1,850. Management expects the pressure to persist through the monsoon.
evidence: कोकिंग कोल की लागत 11% बढ़ने से वेंटेज स्टील का प्रति टन EBITDA ₹1,850 घट गया।

title: Kalyani Auto Components — ₹2,300 crore EV drivetrain order
summary: The order covers drivetrain assemblies for two electric two-wheeler platforms and ramps from the September quarter across three plants in Tamil Nadu.
evidence: Kalyani Auto Components won a ₹2,300 crore order to supply EV drivetrain assemblies for two electric two-wheeler platforms.

title: Deccan Pharma Labs — Form 483 issued for Unit-II
summary: The inspection closed with six observations covering sterility assurance and batch review. Unit-II contributes roughly a fifth of US generic revenue.
evidence: డెక్కన్ ఫార్మా ల్యాబ్స్ యూనిట్-IIకి USFDA ఫారం 483 జారీ చేసింది, ఆరు లోపాలు నమోదయ్యాయి.

title: Orbit Payments — merchant additions steady, take rate flat
summary: The company added 3.1 lakh merchants in the month while UPI take rate held at 0.42%. Management reiterated FY26 EBITDA breakeven.
evidence: Orbit Payments added 3.1 lakh merchants in the month while its UPI take rate was unchanged at 0.42%.

title: Sahyadri Cement — ₹25 per bag price hike absorbed, volumes flat
summary: Dealers absorbed the hike in the west but volumes stayed flat year on year. Freight costs remain the main swing factor for the quarter.
evidence: सह्याद्री सीमेंट ने प्रति बोरी ₹25 की वृद्धि लागू की, लेकिन मात्रा साल-दर-साल स्थिर रही।

title: Trident Renewables — 480 MW hybrid PPA signed with state utility
summary: The 25-year power purchase agreement pairs 320 MW solar with 160 MW wind and is expected to commission in two tranches starting next December.
evidence: Trident Renewables signed a 25-year hybrid power purchase agreement for 480 MW with the state utility.

title: Meridian Grid — Q2 revenue flat, margin guidance trimmed
summary: Transmission availability stayed above 99%, but capitalisation slipped and the company trimmed full-year margin guidance by 80 basis points.
evidence: మెరిడియన్ గ్రిడ్ రెండో త్రైమాసికంలో ఆదాయం స్థిరంగా ఉంది, మార్జిన్ మార్గదర్శకాన్ని 80 బేసిస్ పాయింట్లు తగ్గించింది.
